ACCEPT-LOCAL-SOURCE/EVIDENCE — reviewed source /home/common/projects/templar/blend-contracts-v2 at 273a5131da1f7407887a4a40867c992790809f3d and evidence /home/common/projects/templar/precept at 8a0b063eac2daa43c90e94cb2eb47b4f5a1e3d2a, including doc/adr/reviews/adr-0008-blend-fork-implementation-evidence.md and the exact-local-* custody records, after reading FinalFrozenSecurity’s acceptance of the same pair; no blocking correctness, maintenance, conformance, scope, or safe Ponytail findings remain, with the seven pool restrictions and six backstop traps contained in production commit 23abc743035994a5c0f18855c8cb8f54795dbce8, followed by the single support commit, while preserving the documentation ancestor, baseline 6cf6dd1ca712ea3cf17a767fe49b7da01f80b909, production factory, ABI, build inputs, and normal dependency boundaries.

Evidence is sufficient for this local acceptance: reviewed entrypoint and auction/request consumers, reserve-cache/default/orphan accounting, emissions absence guards, event observations, the pre-state integer property oracle and modeled final-fill success/rollback classification, stock-side divergence controls, constrained differential normalization and mutation controls, canonical XDR custody, and archived concrete observations; the committed terminal receipts show 490 workspace tests passed, the separately invoked ignored differential actually ran and passed one test, and the exact 10,000-case replay with seed 9110008 passed in 28184.17 seconds, while the custody records retain three byte-identical clean local producer builds, 84 equal common observations, and 532 archived differential artifacts with relative manifest paths; this review inspected those records and archive members rather than rerunning validation or independently recomputing Main’s already-verified 66 committed payload hashes, and accepts the documented standalone harness, test-only fixture migrations, retained checkpoint failures, and narrowly scoped normalization under the combined ADR0008/0011 criteria rather than incorrectly applying isolated-backstop requirements.

Acceptance is strictly local-source/evidence, not publication, release, deployment, comprehensive formal verification, or final external-audit approval: preserve the frozen payload and add the final review annex separately, leave unrelated ADR0009 changes and the duplicate ADR0006 untouched, retain stock dormant code and public parameter names rather than widening the accepted executable/ABI scope, honor the authorized commercial/hard-date prepublication timing exception, and keep publication verification, report-to-release audit coverage, independent external review, active-network size limits, deployment configuration and policy/oracle/custody controls, exposure/sunset constraints, and operational readiness as separate applicable gates.
